topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I heard about the whole plagiarism thing, and honestly, I can't sit this one out. First off, I know you, and I know you’d never cheat. I believe in you. We all mess up sometimes, maybe even without realizing it, but this isn’t who you are. People are jumping to conclusions way too fast. What matters now is getting all the facts straight and clearing your name. We’re gonna get through this, and when it’s all sorted, it’s only gonna make us stronger. Just keep your head up, and let’s face this together, okay? You’ve got this, and you’ve got us behind you.
